harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 4.2.7 cluster on Alpine 3.23, created the payments vhost with an application user (appuser) holding full permissions, declared a durable quorum queue "orders" replicated across all 3 nodes, and proved message durability/consumability by publishing a persistent message and successfully consuming it from node2 while node1 was down. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol for all three nodes, verifying changed boot IDs and full cluster/quorum recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Set hostnames and /etc/hosts entries on node1, node2, node3 from CLUSTER_HOSTS
Installed rabbitmq-server 4.2.7 and erlang27 via apk on all three nodes

Generated a shared erlang cookie on node1 and propagated it to node2/node3 via secret_env (SSH was blocked by Alpine's locked root account, so cookie was distributed directly per-node via exec instead)
Enabled and started rabbitmq-server via rc-update/rc-service on all nodes
Joined node2 and node3 to node1's cluster via rabbitmqctl stop_app/join_cluster/start_app
Created the payments vhost, added appuser with full permissions on it, tagged management
Created /etc/rabbitmq/enabled_plugins on all 3 nodes and enabled rabbitmq_management plugin for HTTP API access
Declared a durable quorum queue 'orders' in the payments vhost with x-quorum-initial-group-size 3, confirmed all 3 nodes as members/online
Published a persistent message and captured a healthy baseline (boot_id, uptime, service status) for all 3 nodes

Disrupted node1 (quorum leader) via native reboot; while down, confirmed quorum maintained on node2/node3, new leader elected, message count intact, then consumed the message from node2 confirming the exact payload survived the node loss
Published a second message post-failover to leave a message present for subsequent restarts
Polled node1 until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and uptime reset, verified rabbitmq-server auto-started and rejoined the cluster with quorum queue back to 3/3 online
Repeated capture-baseline -> reboot -> poll-until-reachable -> verify-boot-id-changed -> verify-cluster/quorum-recovered for node2 and node3
Final verification: all 3 nodes running, no network partitions, no alarms, quorum queue 'orders' has all 3 members online with 1 message present

evidence.requirement: Cluster joined: node1, node2, node3 form a single RabbitMQ cluster
evidence.summary: rabbitmq-server started on all 3 nodes as rabbit@node1/node2/node3, then node2 and node3 joined node1's cluster; cluster_status on node3 shows Disk Nodes and Running Nodes = rabbit@node1, rabbit@node2, rabbit@node3

evidence.requirement: payments vhost and application account (appuser) with publish/consume permissions
evidence.summary: add_vhost payments, add_user appuser, set_permissions -p payments appuser ".*" ".*" ".*" all succeeded; list_vhosts shows payments, list_users shows appuser

evidence.requirement: Durable queue whose messages survive loss of any one node and stay consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: Declared durable quorum queue 'orders' (3 members). Published persistent message 'order-12345-durability-test' (messages_persistent:1). Rebooted node1 (the then-leader); with node1 down, node2/node3 cluster_status shows only those two running, a new leader (rabbit@node2) was elected, queue still shows messages:1; consumed the message via node2's HTTP API and got back the exact original payload, then message count returned to 0, proving durability across node loss and consumability from remaining nodes

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/quorum state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 066d82de... captured; reboot acknowledged without hanging; post-reboot boot_id is 3177bf54... (changed) with uptime 0; rabbitmq-server auto-started, rejoined cluster (Running Nodes = all 3), and quorum queue 'orders' shows online:[node1,node2,node3] again

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/quorum state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8b85e8a9... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id is 96051a26... (changed) with uptime 0; rabbitmq-server auto-started, cluster_status shows Running Nodes = all 3, quorum queue online list confirmed as [node1,node2,node3] with members intact

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/quorum state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a1c78213... captured; reboot acknowledged; while node3 down, node1 shows quorum maintained (node1/node2 running, new leader) and message intact; post-reboot boot_id is 75d97a4d... (changed) with uptime 0; full cluster_status shows all 3 nodes running with zero alarms/partitions; final queue check confirms all 3 members online with the post-failover message present
